TEXT:
After practicing with Saori for a while, I brought 
her into my room.

It was about time for Kirino to come home, after 
all.

Plus, to some extent, our special training yielded 
results, so Saori's gotten used to at least holding 
hands with me while my eyes are open.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh yeah, we still haven't told them about us.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You mean Kiririn-san and Kuroneko-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I wonder if it'll be alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
...The reason most circles collapse... it's mostly caused 
by inter-club relationships...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You mean they object and quarrel about it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure worry about strange things.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Even if you say that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What's done is done, there's no use worrying about 
it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
We've already started dating, that can't be stopped 
now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Not only that, there's no way we can keep hiding 
this from them, right? Since they're our friends.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
In that case, we should do what needs to be done. 
We can worry about what comes after seeing their 
reactions.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I believe what you're thinking is right, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
...Honestly, I am jealous... of the way you can be so 
insensitive, Kyosuke-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Umm, that wasn't a compliment just now, was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Oh my, aren't you truly amazing. You have 
understood me, yes?
Unlike Bajeena, Makishima-san uses sarcasm a lot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, putting that problem aside.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Let's plan out the date for tomorrow.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I don't know if it's you living in the moment, or if it's 
you looking forward... but I'm not being sarcastic 
when I say I want to learn from it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
We've solved some of your "shyness", so we can go 
out, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Indeed, probably.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is there somewhere you wanna go?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
...Yes. Actually, there's a place I have been longing to 
visit for a while with you, Kyosuke-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, where, where?

Saori clapped her hands and spoke with a shining 
bright smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [font_size=33]The beach①[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't say such absurd things!
This girl says some crazy things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You said earlier it was impossible for you to hold 
hands, yet you're suddenly trying to jump an 
impossibly high hurdle!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Really, the beach! There are tons of people there, 
and since you have to wear a swimsuit, you'd die!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I-I will be fine! I will not slip up in that regard!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You can't come as Bajeena, alright?
Or else I'd be disappointed.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes, I understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...You tried so hard, so I have no reason to object.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...But, I wonder if things will turn out okay?
